title: Keystone — Free Bootstrap 6 Corporate & Business Website Template
excerpt: A free three-page Bootstrap 6 corporate template built around a real mega menu — keyboard-navigable panels on desktop, a nested drawer on mobile, both from one declaration.
yoastTitle: Keystone — Free Bootstrap 6 Corporate & Business Website Template
yoastDesc: Free Bootstrap 6 corporate and business website template with an accessible mega menu, services, case studies, four offices and a validating enquiry form. No build step.
intro: Keystone is a free, premium Bootstrap 6 corporate and business website template. Three pages — homepage, services and contact — designed for an organisation with more than five things to say about itself.
note: Corporate sites have deep information architecture: four sections, several columns each, forty-odd destinations. Almost every Bootstrap template ships a flat five-item navbar that falls apart the moment a real company uses it. Keystone's mega menu is declared once and rendered twice — as full-width panels on desktop, as nested <details> in the drawer on mobile — so the two navigations cannot drift apart. It is also built to work without a mouse, which hover menus never are: click or Enter opens a panel, Esc closes it and returns focus to its button, tabbing out closes it, and hover only switches panels when one is already open — so a pointer crossing the bar on its way somewhere else never triggers anything. The mobile menu needs no JavaScript at all.
summary: Keystone is a free, premium three-page Bootstrap 6 corporate and business template. The homepage carries a sober hero, a statistics band, four services with concrete deliverables rather than abstractions, three case studies described plainly, and four commitments the firm makes in writing. A services page expands each discipline; a contact page pairs a validating enquiry form with four office addresses and named direct contacts. Its distinguishing feature is the navigation: a mega menu declared once and rendered as desktop panels and a mobile nested-details drawer, fully keyboard operable, with hover that only follows once a panel is already open. Deep navy corporate design, full light and dark mode, ESM-only vanilla JavaScript, no build step.
